description_zh: 调用DescribeLiveMessageApp查询互动消息应用信息
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-message-app --app-id demo --data-center cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveMessageApp

parameters.description_en: The ID of the interactive messaging application to query.
parameters.description_zh: 待查询的互动消息应用ID。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the interactive messaging application to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的互动消息应用ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description_en: The data center. It must be the same as the data center that was specified when you called the [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~) operation to create the interactive messaging application. Valid values: cn-shanghai and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).
parameters.description_zh: 数据中心，需要与[CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~)中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）。
parameters.help_en: The data center. It must be the same as the data center that was specified when you called the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html operation to create the interactive messaging application. Valid values: cn-shanghai and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
